proposed.text: Vault door openings for nitro-cellulose film storage must be of what minimum fire-resistive construction rating per PD 1096, Rule XIV (Sec. 1401)?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1401 requires vault door openings to be of 4-hour fire-resistive construction — the highest standard prescribed under PD 1096. This is the same rating applied to the most critical fire separations in the Code. Vault doors must be kept closed except when in use; a propped-open 4-hour door provides zero protection. This requirement is identical to NFPA 40.
